package.description: A cross-platform GUI helper for Frida that manages devices, targets, scripts, and frida-server for Android injection workflows.

en-US.description: A cross-platform GUI helper for Frida that manages devices, targets, scripts, and frida-server for Android injection workflows.
en-US.longDescription: Frida GUI Helper is a graphical helper for Frida on Windows. It connects ADB devices, attaches to or spawns Android targets, and manages reusable run profiles that save the device, package or target, Attach or Spawn mode, script snapshot, parameters, and frida-server path. It runs pre-injection environment checks, deploys and restarts a matching frida-server with one click, and keeps per-session stdout/stderr logs, exit reasons, exit codes, and durations.
en-US.name: Frida GUI Helper

zh-CN.description: 一个跨平台的 Frida 图形化辅助工具，用于管理设备、目标、脚本与 frida-server，完成 Android 注入工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: Frida GUI Helper 是 Windows 上的 Frida 图形化辅助工具。它可以连接 ADB 设备、Attach 或 Spawn Android 目标，并管理可复用的运行配置（保存设备、包名或目标、注入模式、脚本快照、参数与 frida-server 路径）。它提供注入前环境检查、一键推送并重启匹配的 frida-server，并为每个会话保留独立的 stdout/stderr 日志、退出原因、退出码与运行时长。
